test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)–revised Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) for the entire NCR in November 2025, which measure was advanced from Stage II to Stage I?

options.text: Allowing offices to work on 50% strength and the rest from home
Staggering timings for public offices in Delhi and key NCR districts
Ensuring uninterrupted power supply to discourage use of DG sets
Complete ban on all construction activities across NCR

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ensuring uninterrupted power supply to discourage use of DG sets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)** revised the **Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)** for the **National Capital Region (NCR)** to be implemented for the **2024-25** winter season and beyond.
 
• One of the most significant changes in the revised schedule is the advancement of the measure to **ensure uninterrupted power supply** by **DISCOMs** to discourage the use of **Diesel Generator (DG) sets**.
 
• This specific measure was previously classified under **Stage II (Very Poor)** but has been moved to **Stage I (Poor)** to provide a pre-emptive check on emissions from power backups as soon as air quality starts deteriorating. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***
 
• **Stage I** is triggered when the **Air Quality Index (AQI)** in **Delhi** is between **201 and 300**. By moving this measure to **Stage I**, the **CAQM** aims to minimize **carbon soot** and **particulate matter** emissions
